notes.title: Sand to Surf - Patch 0.2.3.15
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list]
[*] Improved controller support for pause menu and main menu
[*] Player control physics optimization fixes
[*] Fixes to prevent falling through world
[/list]

[h2]Feature Improvements:[/h2][list]
[*] Added keyboard control prompts
[*] Updated menu UI
[*] Added new “Reset to Checkpoint” button in pause menu
[/list]
